# Risk tier per changed path (Fhi.Munin.DevInfra docs/review-risk-tiers.md, read by risk-tier.py). A file takes the
# first tier, in the order high, medium, low, with a matching glob; a file no glob matches is medium.

# Tokens and sign-in: the package sends the host's bearer token to Munin
high   src/Fhi.Munin.Explorer/Client/BearerTokenHandler.cs
high   src/Fhi.Munin.Explorer/Contracts/IMuninExplorerTokenProvider.cs
high   src/Fhi.Munin.Explorer/Contracts/IdentityLink.cs
high   src/Fhi.Munin.Explorer/Contracts/MuninExplorerUnauthorizedException.cs
high   src/Fhi.Munin.Explorer/Client/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs
# The labeller itself, which runs with a write token on every pull request, forks' included
high   .github/actions/**
high   scripts/risk-tier.py
high   .github/CODEOWNERS
# CI, the package release and what it publishes
high   .github/workflows/*.yml
high   .github/workflows/*.yaml
high   scripts/release-changelog.sh
high   scripts/flatten-release-notes.sh
high   scripts/push-packages.sh
high   scripts/assert-package-contents.sh
high   scripts/assemble-changelog.ps1
high   .github/dependabot.yml
high   nuget.config
high   Directory.Build.props
high   src/Fhi.Munin.Explorer/Fhi.Munin.Explorer.csproj

# Files that steer agents and reviewers
medium AGENTS.md
medium CLAUDE.md
medium .claude/**
medium BannedSymbols.txt
medium .github/instructions/**
medium .forge/warden-rules.yaml
medium test/*/*.csproj

# Docs, notes and tests
low    **/*.md
low    docs/**
low    changelog.d/**
low    .forge/**
low    .beads/**
low    test/**
